newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips press higher, techs stuck lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips press higher, techs stuck lower.

text.p: The Dow industrials rallied to nearly match their session highs in mid-afternoon on Wednesday, but tech stocks remained under selling pressure.

The Dow rose 30 points to 7569, while the technology-laden Nasdaq Composite slipped six points to 1396. The performance mirrored Tuesday's, which saw the Dow rise 60.77 points and the Nasdaq Composite fell 10.35 points.
"At the moment, we're seeing a little bit of profit-taking in the techs, but there's nothing disorderly about it," said Alan Ackerman, market strategist at Fahnestock & Co.
The bond market held to its steady tone, with the benchmark 30-year U.S. Treasury up 5/32 to yield 6.83 percent.
